D.t: Jonathan Kreiss-Tomkins leads by 9.2 in the forecast and wins 96% of simulations. The cushion is about 26,904 votes; a one point swing is about 1,454 voters changing sides.
In 8 of 10 simulations the result lands between D +3.1 and D +15.4. Only an unusual polling error changes the winner.
The polls page average is D +8.0. Your best recent poll is Alaska Survey Research at D +8.0; your worst is Data for Progress (D) at R +4.2. 7 polls in the last 30 days.

The biggest vote banks for Democrats: Anchorage Municipality, a projected net 41,124 votes; Juneau City and Borough, a projected net 8,613 votes; Fairbanks North Star Borough, a projected net 8,238 votes. Every point of extra turnout here is worth more than persuasion anywhere else.
The large counties within 12 points: Kenai Peninsula Borough, D +2.8, 9.4% of the vote; Copper River Census Area, R +2.4, 0.4% of the vote.

Groups big enough to move the race: White voters, 76% of voters, 45 to 28, where a 5 point gain is worth 3.81 points; Voters who cast ballots in 2022 and 2024, 69% of voters, 49 to 26, where a 5 point gain is worth 3.46 points; Midsize counties, 68% of voters, 48 to 26, where a 5 point gain is worth 3.42 points.

The forecast's worst groups for Jonathan Kreiss-Tomkins: Immigration voters 22 to 43, Incomes $125K and up 40 to 31, Voters who can afford daily costs 44 to 29. Cutting the loss here is often cheaper than winning new groups.
$1.2M cash against $207K. Spend it early on persuasion television in the battleground counties and keep a reserve for the last week.
Air cover: Outside groups spent $1.6M helping Bernadette Wilson and $1.4M helping Jonathan Kreiss-Tomkins.

R.t: Bernadette Wilson trails by 9.2 and wins 4% of simulations. Closing it takes about 13,452 voters switching sides, or 26,904 more net votes from new turnout.
In 8 of 10 simulations the result lands between D +15.4 and D +3.1. Only an unusual polling error changes the winner.
The polls page average is D +8.0. Your best recent poll is Data for Progress (D) at R +4.2; your worst is Alaska Survey Research at D +8.0. 7 polls in the last 30 days.

The biggest vote banks for Republicans: Matanuska-Susitna Borough, a projected net 6,382 votes; Southeast Fairbanks Census Area, a projected net 854 votes; Copper River Census Area, a projected net 28 votes. Every point of extra turnout here is worth more than persuasion anywhere else.
The large counties within 12 points: Kenai Peninsula Borough, D +2.8, 9.4% of the vote; Copper River Census Area, R +2.4, 0.4% of the vote.

R.h: Where you run behind the 2024 map
R.t: Against the 2024 presidential vote, Bernadette Wilson runs furthest behind in Sitka City and Borough, Kodiak Island Borough, Juneau City and Borough. That is where the forecast sees voters who backed your side two years ago and have not come back yet.

Groups big enough to move the race: White voters, 76% of voters, 28 to 45, where a 5 point gain is worth 3.81 points; Voters who cast ballots in 2022 and 2024, 69% of voters, 26 to 49, where a 5 point gain is worth 3.46 points; Midsize counties, 68% of voters, 26 to 48, where a 5 point gain is worth 3.42 points.

The forecast's worst groups for Bernadette Wilson: Independents 18 to 69, 2024 nonvoters and third party voters 16 to 63, Asian and other voters 19 to 63. Cutting the loss here is often cheaper than winning new groups.
$207K cash against $1.2M. Outspent: lean on earned media, digital, field and the outside groups, and pick the two or three media markets that decide it.
